node A "Device A" ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client/src/edge-client.ts"
node B "Device B" right-of A ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client/src/edge-client.ts"
group cloud "EDGE" max-width=3 {
  node Door "Front door"
  node Router "Router"
  node Db "db"
  node Identity "Identity and Hub"
  node Compute "Compute"
}
edge A -> B "direct link"
edge A:bottom -> Door:left "WebSocket, HTTP"
edge B:bottom -> Door:right "WebSocket, HTTP"
edge Door -> Router, Db, Identity, Compute bus
